description: This Kotlin source file defines data classes, enums, and functions related to configuring and resolving gateway connections in an Android application. It handles parsing and validation of gateway URLs, setup codes, and associated configuration parameters for establishing secure connections to a gateway.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Holds the configuration details for a gateway endpoint, including host, port, TLS usage, and display URL.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Represents a gateway setup code with URL and optional security tokens and password.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Contains the configuration needed to establish a connection to a gateway, including host, port, security credentials, and TLS usage.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enumerates possible validation errors for gateway endpoint URLs, such as invalid URL format or insecure remote URL.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enumerates sources of gateway endpoint input, such as setup code, manual input, or QR scan.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Wraps the result of parsing a gateway endpoint URL, holding either a valid config or an error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Wraps the result of resolving a scanned setup code, including the setup code itself or an error.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a GatewayConnectConfig based on user input, saved data, and fallback tokens.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw gateway endpoint string into a GatewayEndpointConfig.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Parses a raw input string to extract gateway endpoint details, validating URL structure and security.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded setup code string into a GatewaySetupCode object.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Resolves a setup code from scanned input, decoding and parsing it.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Provides detailed result of resolving a scanned setup code, including errors.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly validation message based on the error and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Constructs a manual URL for gateway connection from host, port, and TLS flag.
